title: NATURAL RESOURCE SPECIALIST/SOIL CONSERVATIONIST — Natural Resources Conservation Service
summary: This position is located in the U.S. Department of Agriculture (USDA), Farm Production and Conservation (FPAC) Natural Resources Conservation Service (NRCS). This position is responsible for technical and financial assistance to landowners and operators for implementation of natural resources conservation practices. USDA employees: Please refer to the Next Steps section. $69,789–$109,777 per year
